title: Circuit Current
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the circuit current as 1.5 A using the bulb's rated power and voltage.

title: Motor Voltage
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the motor's rated operating voltage as 5.5 V.

title: Power Supply Power
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the total power of the power supply as 24 W.

title: Apply Loop Law
description: Important: The student must apply Kirchhoff's voltage law to the entire circuit to relate the source EMF to all voltage drops.

title: Identify Normal Operation
description: Important: The student must recognize that 'operate normally' means the bulb operates at its rated voltage (3V) and power (4.5W).

title: Power Formula Application
description: Optional: The student may show the derivation of the circuit current from the bulb's power rating using I = P/U.

title: Incorrect Voltage Summation
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly sums voltage drops, e.g., omitting the voltage drop across the internal resistance r or the fixed resistor R.

title: Unit Omission or Error
description: Pitfall: The student provides numerical answers without correct units (A, V, W) or uses incorrect units.
